name: GymApp (selfhosters)
description: Gym App - A local-first workout tracker for personal or family use. Features 1300+ exercises with GIFs, custom exercises, workout scheduling, body weight tracking, analytics, Excel export, multi-user support, backup/restore, and PWA install on mobile (add to home screen).

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Where the database, uploaded images, and logs are stored. Back this up regularly!

ports.name: Web Port
ports.description: Port to access the web interface. Open http://your-ip:3001 in your browser.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the default admin account on first run. Change this before starting! Only applies when creating a fresh database.

variables.name: Server Port (internal)
variables.description: Internal server port. Keep this matching the Web Port above.

author: selfhosters
